name: travel-retrieval
description: A travel-planning assistant's seeded memory (10 facts, distinct slots) and 8 questions with gold fact ids. Measures whether hybrid recall surfaces the right memories.

facts.text: The Colosseum requires a timed-entry ticket booked two days ahead.
Our Rome apartment is in Trastevere, ten minutes from the tram stop.
The high-speed train to Florence leaves from Santa Maria Novella at 8:15 a.m.
Dinner at Trattoria Bianca is booked for 7:30 p.m. on Saturday.
The Uffizi gallery is closed on Mondays.
Our flight home lands at 6:40 p.m. on Sunday.
The hotel provides a free airport shuttle every 30 minutes.
Travel insurance covers medical evacuation up to 100000 euros.
The cable car to the fortress runs every 20 minutes in summer.
Currency exchange at the airport charges a 4 percent commission.

queries.query: What time does the train to Florence leave?
When does our flight home land?
Is the Uffizi open on Mondays?
How do we get from the airport to the hotel?
What does the travel insurance cover?
Do I need a ticket for the Colosseum?
What is booked for Saturday dinner?
